expertiseSources.summary: Provides the existing correctness, failure, trust-boundary, performance, and compatibility review criteria used by the streamlined workflow.

exception.rationale: This review-only workflow guards against unreviewed diff sections, speculative approvals, unauthorized edits, and unsupported completion claims. The streamlining retains evidence-ranked blocking findings and explicitly separates inspected code from executed checks. Safety cases and independent review are the appropriate gate; no measured model uplift or completed human exception approval is claimed.
